stories.title: Neto detona Memphis após eliminação na Libertadores: ‘Ele desclassificou o Corinthians’

en.title: Neto attacks Memphis after Libertadores elimination: 'He disqualified Corinthians'
en.summary: A sports commentator blamed player Memphis for Corinthians' elimination from the Libertadores Copa competition.

stories.title: Memphis é xingado por torcedores após perder pênalti em eliminação do Corinthians na Libertadores

en.title: Memphis is insulted by fans after missing penalty in Corinthians elimination from Libertadores
en.summary: Supporters directed criticism at player Memphis following his missed penalty kick during Corinthians' Libertadores Copa elimination.

stories.title: Após Lotofácil da Independência pagar R$ 300 milhões, quando será o próximo sorteio especial? Confira

en.title: After Lotofácil da Independência pays R$ 300 million, when will the next special draw be? Check here
en.summary: Brazil's Lotofácil da Independência lottery distributed 300 million reais this week. The next special drawing will be the Mega da Virada on December 31.

stories.title: Veja os memes da eliminação do Corinthians para o Estudiantes na Libertadores

en.title: See the memes from Corinthians elimination to Estudiantes in Libertadores
en.summary: Internet users created humorous content following Corinthians' elimination by Estudiantes in the Libertadores Copa competition.

stories.title: Memphis isola pênalti, Corinthians cai diante do Estudiantes e é eliminado da Libertadores

en.title: Memphis misses penalty, Corinthians falls to Estudiantes and is eliminated from Libertadores
en.summary: Corinthians was eliminated from the Libertadores Cup after losing 1-0 to Estudiantes. Memphis Depay missed a crucial penalty kick in the final minute that could have kept the Brazilian team's semifinal hopes alive.

stories.title: Bradesco arrecada R$ 6,5 bilhões em 1ª etapa de aumento de capital

en.title: Bradesco raises R$ 6.5 billion in first stage of capital increase
en.summary: Bradesco completed the first phase of a capital increase announced in July, raising R$ 6.5 billion through new share issuance. The two-stage operation aims to raise up to R$ 10 billion total.

stories.title: Corinthians sente peso da Libertadores e Memphis sela queda para o Estudiantes ao isolar pênalti

en.title: Corinthians feels weight of Libertadores and Memphis seals fall to Estudiantes by missing penalty
en.summary: Corinthians was eliminated from the Libertadores Cup after losing to Estudiantes, with Memphis Depay missing a penalty kick in the decisive match.

stories.title: Messi faz 100º gol pelo Inter Miami em vitória e título sobre o Cruz Azul

en.title: Messi scores 100th goal for Inter Miami in victory and title over Cruz Azul
en.summary: Lionel Messi scored his 100th goal for Inter Miami in a title-winning victory against Cruz Azul.

stories.title: Veja o que fizeram os candidatos ao governo do AM nesta quarta-feira (16)

en.title: See what candidates for governor of AM did on Wednesday (16)
en.summary: Candidates for Amazonas governor in the 2026 elections participated in press interviews and campaign walks in the state on Wednesday. The first round of voting is scheduled for October 4, with a runoff on October 25 if needed.

stories.title: Trump volta a negar visto de presidente da Autoridade Palestina às vésperas de Assembleia-Geral da ONU

en.title: Trump again denies visa to Palestinian Authority president on eve of UN General Assembly
en.summary: The United States denied a visa to Palestinian Authority president Mahmoud Abbas to attend next week's UN General Assembly in New York, according to sources.

stories.title: Veja como foi a quarta-feira (16) dos presidenciáveis

en.title: See how presidential candidates spent Wednesday (16)
en.summary: Presidential candidates conducted campaign activities on Wednesday including podcast interviews, radio and television appearances, and rallies. Some candidates participated in door-to-door campaigning and public events.

stories.title: Memphis isola pênalti e Corinthians é eliminado da Libertadores pelo Estudiantes

en.title: Memphis misses penalty and Corinthians is eliminated from Libertadores by Estudiantes
en.summary: Corinthians was eliminated from the Copa Libertadores quarterfinals after losing 1-0 to Estudiantes de La Plata. Memphis Depay missed a late penalty kick that could have changed the result.

stories.title: Lula chama governadora do DF de cínica e diz que governo não dará dinheiro ao BRB

en.title: Lula calls DF governor cynical and says government will not give money to BRB
en.summary: President Lula held a campaign event in the Federal District and criticized Governor Celina Leão, stating the federal government will not provide funds to rescue Banco de Brasília. He also commented on high food prices and expressed dissatisfaction with minimum wage levels.

stories.title: Governo Lula refuta acusação de falha no combate a facções e diz que EUA ignoram esforços brasileiros

en.title: Lula government refutes US accusation of failure in combating factions and says USA ignores Brazilian efforts
en.summary: Brazil's Justice Ministry issued a statement rejecting US claims that Brazil failed to address organized crime internationally. The government highlighted initiatives including anti-faction legislation and a crime prevention program, noting existing bilateral cooperation with the United States.

stories.title: Juíza decide que Google deve flexibilizar regras de tecnologia de publicidade

en.title: Judge decides Google should loosen advertising technology rules
en.summary: A US federal judge ruled that Google must relax regulations governing its online advertising auctions and appoint an internal antitrust compliance monitor, while stopping short of requiring the company to divest its advertising technology business.

stories.title: Falta de dupilumabe no SUS leva menores à Justiça

en.title: Shortage of dupilumab in SUS leads minors to court
en.summary: Dupilumab, a medication for severe atopic dermatitis in children aged 6 to 11, was incorporated into Brazil's public health system in 2024 but shortages in state supplies have prompted families to seek judicial intervention for treatment access.

stories.title: Almah lança nova IA para administradoras de condomínios

en.title: Almah launches new AI for condominium administrators
en.summary: Brazilian technology company Almah has introduced Mah, an artificial intelligence tool integrated into its platform that allows condominium administrators to perform routine administrative and financial tasks through chat commands.
